title: Security Review: BMTC Transit API v0.2.0 (STRIDE-lite)
summary: STRIDE-based security/privacy audit of BMTC API v0.2.0 identifying tampering, DoS, and information disclosure findings.
notes: Filename date-prefix superficially resembles ADR numbering, but content is a findings/audit report (Executive Summary, Findings, Checklist, Recommendations, Sign-off) with no Decision/Consequences or Accepted/Proposed status fields. Classified as DOC (security audit context) rather than ADR.
